pages.text: Nothing in Emberveil is required. If you want a direction, here are a few ways people play it. Mix them freely.

$(li)$(l)The Delver$() clears rebuilt dungeons, strongholds and temples for loot and accessories.$(li)$(l)The Hunter$() tracks down bosses one tier at a time.$(li)$(l)The Collector$() gathers unique relic weapons and accessories. See $(l:deeds/overview)deeds/overview$(/l).

$(li)$(l)The Wanderer$() maps the world, links it with waystones and records wildlife.$(li)$(l)The Homesteader$() builds a base, farms, cooks and tames companions.$(li)$(l)The Smith$() chases boss materials to forge the best armour and weapons.
The $(l:deeds/overview)Deeds$(/l) tab tracks optional goals if you enjoy ticking things off.
